name: Pranav
text: From 1100 to 1800+ rating in only 13 months. Later crossed 2300 FIDE rating and earned the National Master title (2023).

name: Vyom
text: California State Champion at 10, National Grade K-6 Champion at 12, FIDE Master and International Master at 14, Pan American Junior Champion at 15.
facts: Pan American Junior Champion at age 15
